primary_meaning: A visual reminder to remember and obey all of God's commandments and to live a holy life set apart from sin

alternatives.meaning: The fringe or hem of Jesus' garment as a source of healing power and messianic authority, fulfilled when the woman with the issue of blood touched it
A symbol of the covenant people of God or Jewish identity under the Mosaic Law, now fulfilled or set aside in Christ
The blue thread (tekhelet) specifically representing heaven, divinity, or the throne of God

notes: The explicit purpose statement in Numbers 15 supplies a clear primary meaning that is consistently recognized in Christian biblical interpretation of the Old Testament command; secondary Christian applications center on New Testament references to Jesus' tassels but do not displace the original stated symbolism.
